answer: Before an agent can earn rewards, the network holds a 40,000 POA registration bond for 10 epochs. Creating 80 fake agents costs 3,200,000 POA locked for 60 hours with no early release. Funding those keys from many wallets does not help because each key carries its own bond and unlock clock. An honest agent posts the bond once, works under one key, and receives a full refund when the lock ends. A weather station on the tundra, a cargo jetty, and the trade horizon each run one bonded key rather than a farm of clones.
